description: Combined PRD evidence from two isolated Codex/Ralph stream worktrees. Verification and PR gate run on this integration branch.

userStories.title: Reject trailing tokens in shared JSON request decoding
userStories.story: As an API client and operator, I want Weave handlers that use the shared JSON decoder to reject request bodies containing extra JSON values or trailing junk so malformed or smuggled payloads cannot be partially accepted.
userStories.scope: Backend shared HTTP utility plus a representative OSS HTTP handler regression test.
bddAcceptance: Given an OSS SearchObjects request body that starts with a valid JSON object and then contains a second JSON object, when the request is posted, then the handler returns HTTP 400 with errorName InvalidRequestBody.
Given the same request path with a single valid JSON object, when the request is posted, then the handler continues to accept and execute it.
Given the shared httputil.ReadJSON helper, when the body contains trailing non-whitespace after the first JSON value, then ReadJSON returns an error instead of silently decoding the first value.

userStories.title: Saved Browser Searches Hydrate the Visible Search Box
userStories.summary: Loading a Browser saved search with searchText must update both the query state and the visible search input so operators can trust and edit the active object search.
bddAcceptanceCriteria: Given an operator is on /browser/:ontology/:objectType and a saved search contains searchText 'OpenAI', when they click that saved search, then the Search objects input visibly contains 'OpenAI'.
Given that same saved search is loaded, when BrowserPage posts to /search, then the where clause is containsAnyTerm on the title property with value 'OpenAI' as a string.
Given the operator clears the hydrated input, when the input becomes empty, then BrowserPage returns to the unfiltered list request.

userStories.title: Browser Bulk Selection Clears on Query Context Changes
userStories.summary: Bulk action state should not retain hidden rows after search, filter, saved-search, or facet changes replace the active result set.
bddAcceptanceCriteria: Given a row is selected in the unfiltered Browser table, when the operator applies a text search, then the bulk toolbar clears before actions can target stale rows.
Given rows are selected on one filtered result set, when the operator loads a saved search, then only rows explicitly selected after the saved search load are eligible for bulk actions.

userStories.title: Browser Live Mode Surfaces SSE Fallback Provisioning Failures
userStories.summary: The Browser live toggle should expose a clear inline failure if WebSocket reconnects and the temporary ObjectSet needed for the documented SSE fallback cannot be created.
bddAcceptanceCriteria: Given Live mode is enabled and the WebSocket transport enters reconnecting, when createTemporaryObjectSet fails, then the Browser header shows a failed fallback status instead of staying in an indefinite connecting state.
Given the operator turns Live off after that failure, when they turn it on again, then the fallback error is cleared and the Browser retries provisioning.
